recent_posts.title: Architecting a High-Performance Data Mover: Why Rust is my Backend of Choice
recent_posts.summary: A developer shares their architectural decision to build a data processing backend in Rust rather than handling it within Flutter. The approach leverages Rust's ownership model for thread safety, avoids garbage collection for memory efficiency, and uses flutter_rust_bridge for communication while keeping the UI responsive. The author positions this as part of a broader industry trend toward Rust-based data movement tools that challenge traditional ETL platforms through fearless concurrency and reduced memory footprint.

recent_posts.title: Full-Stack Mobile Development (Flutter + Serverpod) #2 - Serverpod Installation and Setup
recent_posts.summary: A hands-on guide to installing and configuring Serverpod 2.9.0 for full-stack Dart development. Covers prerequisite setup including Flutter 3.24+, Docker Desktop for Postgres, and the Serverpod CLI installation. Walks through creating a new Serverpod project, configuring Docker containers, installing VS Code extensions and Serverpod Insights, and starting a local development server. Addresses common setup pitfalls like Docker daemon issues, CLI PATH configuration, and database connection failures that affect many developers during initial setup.

recent_posts.title: Full-Stack Mobile Development with Flutter & Serverpod #1 - What is Serverpod? Why go Full-Stack?
recent_posts.summary: Serverpod is an open-source, Dart-based backend framework designed specifically for Flutter developers. It eliminates the need to switch languages for backend development by providing automatic code generation, a native Postgres ORM, built-in authentication, real-time WebSockets, and cloud deployment capabilities. The framework enables full-stack Dart development, reducing context switching and development time while offering type-safe APIs, distributed caching, file uploads, and monitoring dashboards. This approach addresses common pain points like Firebase vendor lock-in and polyglot stack complexity.
